newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Q Data mulling new restructure proposal.
newsitem.headline: Q Data mulling new restructure proposal.

text.p: South Africa's Grinaker Holdings Ltd group said on Friday that it had received an alternative proposal to a deal announced on June 27 this year, which has an impact on this transaction.
It said that in the interests of shareholders the board of group firm Q Data Ltd was considering this alternative proposal.

The electronics to construction group announced a restructure in June which would see Q Data and black-owned Kunene Bros buy equal 25.5 percent stakes in Grinaker Holdings and 2.625 percent interests in Grintek Ltd from parent Anglovaal Industries Ltd.

Shares in Q Data jumped on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Thursday. Dealers attributed the rise to news the company had signed a hardware and software supply deal with medical firm Interdoc worth at least three million.
Shareholders were on Friday advised to exercise caution in their share dealings.

Ahead of the June announcement analysts had expected the Grinaker group to streamline its electronics interests, suggesting a possible collapse of pyramid firm Grinaker and the housing of Grintek's electronics interests in other group firm Siltek Ltd.
